context.title: NFIB (National Federation of Independent Business) — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements (California picks only)

subject.title: California — Proposition 3 (Provides Permanent Funding for Schools and Health Care by Extending Existing Tax on High Incomes)

positions.statement: "PROPOSITION 3: OPPOSE—Permanently extends state income tax hikes (originally opposed by NFIB in 2012)"

subject.title: California — Proposition 40 (Imposes One-Time Tax on Certain Taxpayers)

positions.statement: "PROPOSITION 40: OPPOSE—Billionaire’s tax, imposing a 5% tax on total assets"

subject.title: California — Proposition 41 (Prohibits New State Taxes That Exclude Revenues from State Spending Limit. Requires Audits for New State Special Taxes)

positions.statement: "PROPOSITION 41: SUPPORT—Requires audit of any new special taxes"

subject.title: California — Proposition 42 (Prohibits New State Personal Property Taxes and Certain Retroactive State Taxes)

positions.statement: "PROPOSITION 42: SUPPORT—Prohibits new state personal property taxes and certain retroactive state taxes"

subject.title: California — Proposition 43 (Limits Voters' Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services)

positions.statement: "PROPOSITION 43: SUPPORT—Requires 2/3 voter approval for any new special taxes"

subject.title: California — Proposition 45 (Modifies Environmental Review for Certain Projects)

positions.statement: "PROPOSITION 45: SUPPORT—Changes state environmental law to cut red tape, expedite building process."
